en_title: GTA 6's Waink App Can Unlock New Hairstyles and Make-up
cn_title: 《GTA 6》的Waink应用可以解锁新发型和妆容
opus_summary: 《GTA 6》玩家可使用Waink扫描特定杂志，为Jason解锁新发型，为Lucia解锁发型和妆容。作者找到一本杂志后解锁了Pop Star妆容，它似乎是15种「Lucia杂志造型」之一。Rockstar已确认游戏有额外发型，但尚未公布Waink发型解锁机制的官方说明。

paragraphs.en: We all know that finding magazines around Leonida is one of GTA's collectible quests, and we all know that the Waink app can be used to scan cars for information or street art. It turns out that it can also be used to scan specific magazines to unlock new hairstyles for Jason, as well as hair and makeup looks for Lucia — but these magazines are significantly harder to find.
paragraphs.cn: 我们都知道，在Leonida各处寻找杂志是《侠盗猎车手》的收集任务之一，也都知道Waink应用可以用来扫描汽车以获取信息，或扫描街头艺术。事实证明，它还可以扫描特定杂志，为Jason解锁新发型，以及为Lucia解锁发型和妆容——但这些杂志要难找得多。

paragraphs.en: I found one sitting by a chair in a random, but otherwise pretty boring part of Key Lento. It's not a magazine you can pick up and read like the collectible ones, but a scan with the Waink app unlocked a new Pop Star makeup style. It's apparently one of 15 "Lucia Magazine Styles" to unlock, and I imagine it's a similar number of facial hair and hair unlocks for Jason.
paragraphs.cn: 我在Key Lento一个随意且除此之外相当无聊的地方，发现一本放在椅子旁的杂志。它不像可收集的杂志那样可以捡起来阅读，但用Waink应用扫描后，我解锁了一款新的流行歌星妆容。这显然是15种可解锁的「Lucia杂志造型」之一，我猜Jason可解锁的胡须和发型数量也差不多。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar has confirmed that additional hairstyles are available in GTA 6 , including those offered through the Vintage Vice City Pack, but it hasn’t published official instructions detailing how Waink’s hairstyle unlocks work. It's just another one of those fun little secrets that players have been left to find for themselves. So far I've only found one, but I'm now on a very serious hunt for the rest. The good news is that you do get a Waink prompt when you're close to one, so if you've been in any stores or locations wondering what the hell was setting it off, this might have been the answer.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar已经确认，《GTA 6》中有额外的发型，包括通过Vintage Vice City Pack提供的发型，但尚未发布官方说明，详细介绍Waink的发型解锁机制。这只是又一个留给玩家自行发现的有趣小秘密。到目前为止我只找到了一本，但现在我正在非常认真地寻找其余的。好消息是，当你靠近其中一本时，确实会收到Waink提示，所以如果你曾在某家商店或某个地点纳闷到底是什么触发了提示，这可能就是答案。

paragraphs.en: This has now unlocked a whole new collectibles obsession for me, as if the books, magazines, collectible cars, birds, street art, and everything else you can find in our official guide weren't enough. This game will never let me know peace again.
paragraphs.cn: 这下我又对一种全新的收集品着了迷，仿佛书籍、杂志、收藏汽车、鸟类、街头艺术，以及你能在我们的官方指南中找到的其他所有东西还不够似的。这款游戏再也不会让我安宁了。

paragraphs.en: Just getting started in GTA 6 or wondering what to do next? Check out the Official Grand Theft Auto 6 guide right here on IGN. If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips and Chapter 2 Guide and Tips . If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map .
paragraphs.cn: 刚开始玩《GTA 6》，或者不知道接下来该做什么？不妨查看IGN上的《GTA 6》官方指南。如果你还在熟悉情况，可以通过新手指南——67条提示与技巧了解《侠盗猎车手》的新系统，或者通过第1章指南与提示和第2章指南与提示了解最初几章的全部细节。如果你已经驾车游遍Leonida，想知道所有可以发现的内容和可以做的事情，请查看Leonida互动地图。
